role_repair_analysis.node_purpose: Let Operating and Value reconsider only their independently rejected financial propositions.
role_repair_analysis.input_scale: One immutable role workpaper, role-local context, feedback receipts and unchanged authority sets per role.
role_repair_analysis.required_outputs: One substantive revised natural draft for Operating and one for Value without invented facts.
role_repair_analysis.schema_burden: Repair context carries prior judgment, affected surfaces and immutable evidence, numeric, relation and gap references.
role_repair_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: Very high because contribution, cohort and product pricing-power semantics affect financial truth.
role_repair_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: R7 Cash, Counterevidence and Demand drafts completed at 32000 tokens; Operating and Value were not called.
role_repair_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking=max with max_tokens 32000 for genuine financial reconsideration.
role_repair_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One draft per unfinished role and zero retry; failure preserves all R7 and earlier valid nodes.

role_repair_submission.node_purpose: Correctly remap the preserved Demand draft and map the new Operating and Value drafts into strict workpapers.
role_repair_submission.input_scale: Three role-local drafts plus compact submission views, feedback and locked reference authority.
role_repair_submission.required_outputs: Three valid repaired workpapers with every authority set unchanged and the Demand gap not promoted to fact.
role_repair_submission.schema_burden: Nested thesis, claims, mechanism, alternatives, counterarguments and change conditions remain role-local.
role_repair_submission.materiality_quality_risk: A mapper error could erase a correction or smuggle authority, so exact local comparison remains mandatory.
role_repair_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R7 strict submissions succeeded for Cash and Counterevidence; Demand HTTP 200 failed one claim-binding predicate.
role_repair_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking disabled with max_tokens 8000 because the financial analysis already exists.
role_repair_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One Tool Call per unfinished submission and zero retry; invalid JSON, new references or truncation fail closed.

lead_recheck_analysis.node_purpose: Compare the five repaired workpapers with unchanged Supply before independent reassessment.
lead_recheck_analysis.input_scale: Six validated workpapers after seven bound findings and no new evidence or data authority.
lead_recheck_analysis.required_outputs: One materiality-ranked Lead draft that proceeds or identifies a catalog-bound unresolved challenge.
lead_recheck_analysis.schema_burden: Lead may select only challenges compiled from the six current workpapers and cannot author facts.
lead_recheck_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: A false proceed repeats R5 semantic failure while an unbounded loop overfits the workflow.
lead_recheck_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: R5 Lead completed naturally but missed seven errors; R7 did not reach the Lead frontier.
lead_recheck_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking=max with max_tokens 32000 for cross-role financial comparison.
lead_recheck_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One natural Lead draft and zero retry; off-catalog or truncated output preserves the frontier.

lead_recheck_submission.node_purpose: Map the Lead recheck into the strict catalog-bound decision without changing its routing judgment.
lead_recheck_submission.input_scale: One Lead draft plus deterministic challenge catalog derived from six post-repair workpapers.
lead_recheck_submission.required_outputs: One valid accepted and deferred challenge set, rationale and consistent next state.
lead_recheck_submission.schema_burden: Identifiers must be unique catalog members and next state must match unresolved work.
lead_recheck_submission.materiality_quality_risk: A mapper error could falsely unlock Writer, so invalid decisions remain terminal.
lead_recheck_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R5 Lead strict submission succeeded with this profile; R7 made no Lead attempt.
lead_recheck_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking disabled with max_tokens 8000 for strict mapping only.
lead_recheck_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One Tool Call and zero retry; invalid identifiers or truncation fail closed.

owner_decision_basis: R7 preserved six HTTP-200 calls, two completed repairs and one valid Demand natural draft. The bounded R8 successor rejects the invalid Demand strict submission, returns typed local feedback, and resumes only the seven unfinished semantic nodes.
known_boundary: This decision authorizes one R8 successor over immutable R5 and R7 evidence. It reuses Cash and Counterevidence repairs and the Demand natural draft, rejects the invalid Demand strict submission, and allows exactly one Demand resubmission, two remaining role analysis/submission pairs and one Lead pair, at most seven new Provider calls. It authorizes no S1/S2, retrieval, external source, Candidate promotion, retry, fallback, Writer, S3 acceptance, generalization, publication or release. Independent L1/L2 and content reassessment remain mandatory.
